description.en: Persistent psychotic symptoms including delusions and hallucinations
description.hi: भ्रम और मतिभ्रम सहित लगातार मनोवैज्ञानिक लक्षण

mappingNote: ICD-11 Schizophrenia is 6A20 within the 6A20-6A24 primary psychotic grouping (6A21 schizoaffective, 6A22 schizotypal, 6A23 acute and transient psychotic, 6A24 delusional). DSM schizophreniform and brief psychotic disorders do not map automatically to 6A23 (index 2.1.2-2.1.3).
